```{r}

# are kept as their own variant type (not merged into SVs).

variant_cfg <- list(
  SNPs = list(
    # 96-strain file (MAF 15% computed across all 96 strains)
    geno         = "/projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/the_vcfs/pan_transcriptome_paper/SNPs/SNPs_96_strain_filtering_no_change_name/SNPs_96_strains_MAF15_filtering/SNPs.96strains.maf15.plink"
  ),
  CNVs = list(
    geno         = "/projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/the_vcfs/structural_variant_vcf/SVcalls2/SVcalls/CNVs_96_strains/CNV_96strains_maf15/CNVs.96strains.maf15.plink"
  ),
  InDels = list(
    geno         = "/projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/the_vcfs/vcf_files_sent_by_Anne/SNPs_indels/modified_snp_indel_plink_for_96strains/Indels_only_96/indels.96samples"
  ),
  SVs = list(
    geno         = "/projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/the_vcfs/structural_variant_vcf/SVcalls2/SVcalls/SVs_1087/SVs_96/SV_96_maf_15/SV.96strains.maf15.plink"
```

#Categorize SV types
```{r}
# Read the SVs .bim file (PLINK bim: CHR, SNP, CM, POS, A1, A2)
sv_bim <- read.table(paste0(variant_cfg$SVs$geno, ".bim"), header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(sv_bim) <- c("CHR", "SNP", "CM", "POS", "A1", "A2")

# Total number of SVs
cat("Total number of SVs:", nrow(sv_bim), "\n")

# Extract SV subtypes from the SNP column (format: ID_TYPE_CHR_POS_len_SIZE_[TyRelated])
sv_bim$SV_subtype <- sapply(strsplit(sv_bim$SNP, "_"), function(parts) {
  if (length(parts) >= 2) {
    return(parts[2])
  }
  return("Unknown")
})

# Number of SVs per subtype
table(sv_bim$SV_subtype)

# Assign broad categories based on subtype
sv_bim$SV_broad_category <- NA
sv_bim$SV_broad_category[sv_bim$SV_subtype %in% c("INS", "DEL")] <- "PAVs"
sv_bim$SV_broad_category[sv_bim$SV_subtype %in% c("DUP", "CONTR")] <- "CNVs"
sv_bim$SV_broad_category[sv_bim$SV_subtype %in% c("TRA", "INV")] <- "Structural Rearrangements"

# Number of SVs per broad category
table(sv_bim$SV_broad_category, useNA = "ifany")
```

## Check strain IDs in the 96-strain SV .fam file against sample_used.txt (the old full966 SV file was missing SACE_YCY and had AVI written as AVI_1a)
```{r}
#Another SV .fam file to check the number of strains
sv_96 <- read.table(
  "/projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/the_vcfs/structural_variant_vcf/SVcalls2/SVcalls/SVs_1087/SVs_96/SV_96_maf_15/SV.96strains.maf15.plink.fam",
  header = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# The .fam file stores most strain IDs in both columns (V1 == V2, e.g.
# "AAA AAA"), but strains whose name has an underscore (e.g. SACE_YBJ) are
# split across the two columns instead (V1 = "SACE", V2 = "YBJ"). Rebuild
# the underscore-joined ID only for those split rows so it matches the
# single-column format used in sample_used.txt.
sv_96_ids <- ifelse(sv_96$V1 == sv_96$V2, sv_96$V1, paste(sv_96$V1, sv_96$V2, sep = "_"))

#now Is all the strains in sample_used.txt present in the .fam file?
all(sample_used$V1 %in% sv_96_ids)

#number of strains that are in sample_used.txt but not in the .fam file and also the name and vice versa
not_in_fam <- setdiff(sample_used$V1, sv_96_ids)
not_in_sample_used <- setdiff(sv_96_ids, sample_used$V1)
cat("Strains in sample_used.txt but not in .fam file:", not_in_fam, "\n")
#also print the number of strains that are in sample_used.txt but not in the .fam file
cat("Number of strains in sample_used.txt but not in .fam file:", length(not_in_fam), "\n")

#also print the number of strains that are in .fam file but not in sample_used.txt
cat("Number of strains in .fam file but not in sample_used.txt:", length(not_in_sample_used), "\n")
```

```{r}
colnames(indel_bim) <- c("CHR", "SNP", "CM", "POS", "A1", "A2")

# Total number of InDels
```

#Categorize gene CNVs. Variant IDs look like YAL069W_Cov0.25, i.e. GENE_CovX, where X is a relative-coverage threshold for that gene (1 = normal copy number). A gene can therefore contribute several markers (one per threshold). Thresholds below 1 are copy-number losses and thresholds above 1 are copy-number gains.
```{r}
# Each CNV marker is a below/above split of the gene's normalized depth at the
# threshold in its name, called per strain. Normalized depth 1 = the isolate's
# genome-wide median (normal copy number; all 96 strains are diploid, so one
# copy = 0.5). Allele coding (checked on full1086.CNVs.MAC1.plink using the
# nesting of thresholds, i.e. below 0.25 must imply below 0.75, which holds for
# all 3,173 genes with both markers only under this coding):
#   allele "2" = normalized depth BELOW the threshold
#   allele "1" = normalized depth ABOVE the threshold
# e.g. a strain with allele "2" at GENE_Cov0.25 has lost the gene completely.
# All calls are homozygous (1/1 or 2/2). PLINK orders A1/A2 by minor allele, so
# A1/A2 position (and the 0/1/2 code from read_plink_bed) differ between
# markers; use the allele label, not its position, to interpret a strain's state.
# Remove chromosome 17 (unplaced, non-reference gene families), as in Fig. 3.
# cnv_bim_all keeps every marker so the .bed file can still be read in full;
# cnv_keep selects the retained rows of the genotype matrix later on.
cnv_bim_all <- cnv_bim
cnv_keep    <- cnv_bim_all$CHR != 17
cnv_bim     <- cnv_bim_all[cnv_keep, ]
cat("Gene-based CNV markers on chromosome 17 removed:", sum(!cnv_keep),
    "- remaining:", nrow(cnv_bim), "\n")

cnv_bim$Gene <- sub("_Cov[0-9.]+$", "", cnv_bim$SNP)
cnv_bim$Cov_threshold <- as.numeric(sub("^.*_Cov", "", cnv_bim$SNP))

cnv_bim$Variant_Subtype <- ifelse(
  is.na(cnv_bim$Cov_threshold), "Unknown",
  ifelse(cnv_bim$Cov_threshold < 1, "Loss", "Gain")
)

# Number of CNV markers per subtype
table(cnv_bim$Variant_Subtype, useNA = "ifany")

# Number of distinct genes with a CNV marker, overall and per subtype
cat("Number of genes with at least one CNV marker:", length(unique(cnv_bim$Gene)), "\n")
tapply(cnv_bim$Gene, cnv_bim$Variant_Subtype, function(g) length(unique(g)))
```

indel_data$Variant_Subtype <- sapply(strsplit(indel_data$SNP, "_"), function(parts) {
  if (length(parts) >= 4) {
    ref_allele <- parts[3]
    alt_allele <- parts[4]
    
    ref_len <- nchar(ref_allele)
    alt_len <- nchar(alt_allele)
    
    if (alt_len > ref_len) {
      return("INS")
    } else if (ref_len > alt_len) {
      return("DEL")
    } else if (ref_len == alt_len && ref_len > 1) {
      return("MNV")
    } else {
      return("Unknown")
    }
  }
  return("Unknown")
})

Here, I need to categorization using the .bim file

```{r}
  # Only for InDels: categorize variants as INS, DEL, or MNV using the .bim file.
  # The variant ID is expected to have the format chromosome_position_REF_ALT.
  indel_data <- indel_bim

  indel_alleles <- strsplit(as.character(indel_data$SNP), "_", fixed = TRUE)

  indel_data$REF <- vapply(indel_alleles, function(parts) {
    if (length(parts) >= 4) parts[3] else NA_character_
  }, character(1))

  indel_data$ALT <- vapply(indel_alleles, function(parts) {
    if (length(parts) >= 4) parts[4] else NA_character_
  }, character(1))

  indel_data$Variant_Subtype <- ifelse(
    is.na(indel_data$REF) | is.na(indel_data$ALT),
    "Unknown",
    ifelse(
      nchar(indel_data$ALT) > nchar(indel_data$REF), "INS",
      ifelse(
        nchar(indel_data$REF) > nchar(indel_data$ALT), "DEL",
        ifelse(nchar(indel_data$REF) > 1, "MNV", "Unknown")
      )
    )
  )

  # Number of InDels in each subtype.
  table(indel_data$Variant_Subtype, useNA = "ifany")
```


#compute if the number of strains in the .fam file and the number of strains in the sample_used.txt file are equal. If not, print the number of strains in each file and the difference. Do this for Indels and SNPs. 
```{r}
# Read the .fam file for InDels

indel_fam <- read.table(paste0(variant_cfg$InDels$geno, ".fam"), header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Read the .fam file for SNPs.
snp_fam <- read.table(paste0(variant_cfg$SNPs$geno, ".fam"), header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Read the .fam file for CNVs.
cnv_fam <- read.table(paste0(variant_cfg$CNVs$geno, ".fam"), header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Compare the number of strains in sample_used.txt with each .fam file.
compare_strain_counts <- function(fam_data, variant_type) {
  sample_count <- nrow(sample_used)
  fam_count <- nrow(fam_data)

  if (sample_count == fam_count) {
    cat(variant_type, ": counts are equal (", sample_count, " strains)\n", sep = "")
  } else {
    cat(variant_type, ": counts are not equal\n", sep = "")
    cat("  sample_used.txt: ", sample_count, " strains\n", sep = "")
    cat("  .fam file: ", fam_count, " strains\n", sep = "")
    cat("  Difference (sample_used.txt - .fam): ", sample_count - fam_count, " strains\n", sep = "")
  }
}

compare_strain_counts(indel_fam, "InDels")
compare_strain_counts(snp_fam, "SNPs")
compare_strain_counts(cnv_fam, "CNVs")


```




```{r}
# The .fam file stores most strain IDs in both columns (V1 == V2, e.g.
# "AAA AAA"), but strains whose name has an underscore (e.g. SACE_YBJ) are
# split into a family ID and an individual ID across the two columns instead
# (V1 = "SACE", V2 = "YBJ"). Join V1 and V2 only when they differ so the
# result matches the single-column, underscore-joined format used in
# sample_used.txt. Not every strain has an underscore, so this only changes
# the rows where V1 != V2.
normalize_fam_ids <- function(fam_data) {
  ifelse(fam_data$V1 == fam_data$V2, fam_data$V1, paste(fam_data$V1, fam_data$V2, sep = "_"))
}

compare_strain_ids <- function(fam_data, variant_type) {
  fam_ids <- normalize_fam_ids(fam_data)
  missing_from_fam <- setdiff(sample_used$V1, fam_ids)
  extra_in_fam <- setdiff(fam_ids, sample_used$V1)

  cat(variant_type, ": ", length(intersect(sample_used$V1, fam_ids)),
      " matching strains\n", sep = "")
  cat("  In sample_used.txt but not in .fam (", length(missing_from_fam), "): ",
      paste(missing_from_fam, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
}

compare_strain_ids(indel_fam, "InDels")
compare_strain_ids(snp_fam, "SNPs")
compare_strain_ids(sv_96, "SVs")
compare_strain_ids(cnv_fam, "CNVs")
```

#Make a table with number of SNPs, Indels and SVs and their respective subtypes.
#The table should have the following columns: Variant Type, subtype, total number of variants
```{r}
# SNPs are not split into subtypes, so they get a single "SNP" row.
snp_summary <- data.frame(
  `Variant Type` = "SNPs",
  Subtype = "SNP",
  `Total number of variants` = nrow(snp_bim),
  check.names = FALSE
)

# InDels: subtypes (INS, DEL, MNV) were computed above in indel_data$Variant_Subtype.
indel_summary <- as.data.frame(table(indel_data$Variant_Subtype), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(indel_summary) <- c("Subtype", "Total number of variants")
indel_summary <- cbind(`Variant Type` = "InDels", indel_summary)

# SVs: subtypes are parsed from the variant ID (parts[2] of the SNP column), as above.
sv_subtype <- sapply(strsplit(sv_bim$SNP, "_"), function(parts) {
  if (length(parts) >= 2) parts[2] else "Unknown"
})
sv_summary <- as.data.frame(table(sv_subtype), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(sv_summary) <- c("Subtype", "Total number of variants")
sv_summary <- cbind(`Variant Type` = "SVs", sv_summary)

# Gene-based CNVs (own variant type, chr 17 removed): subtypes Loss / Gain
# computed above in cnv_bim$Variant_Subtype. Counts are gene x coverage-
# threshold markers, not independent CNV events.
cnv_summary <- as.data.frame(table(cnv_bim$Variant_Subtype), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(cnv_summary) <- c("Subtype", "Total number of variants")
cnv_summary <- cbind(`Variant Type` = "Gene-based CNVs", cnv_summary)

# Combine into one table with the requested columns.
variant_summary_table <- rbind(snp_summary, indel_summary, sv_summary, cnv_summary)
variant_summary_table <- variant_summary_table[, c("Variant Type", "Subtype", "Total number of variants")]

knitr::kable(variant_summary_table, row.names = FALSE)

# Table 1: variant type / subtype / total count for the 96 strains used in this study.
write.csv(variant_summary_table, "../results/Table1_variant_type_subtype_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

#Next, I want to find SNP differences between strains in sample_used. For examples, which strains in the have the most SNP difference and the least SNP difference. What is the average SNP difference between the strains?
```{r}
# Read a PLINK .bed file (SNP-major mode) into an n_snps x n_ind genotype
# matrix. Genotype codes follow PLINK's convention: 0 = homozygous A1/A1,
# 1 = heterozygous, 2 = homozygous A2/A2, NA = missing.
read_plink_bed <- function(bed_file, n_snps, n_ind) {
  con <- file(bed_file, "rb")
  on.exit(close(con))

  magic <- readBin(con, what = "raw", n = 3)
  stopifnot(magic[1] == as.raw(0x6c), magic[2] == as.raw(0x1b), magic[3] == as.raw(0x01))

  bytes_per_snp <- ceiling(n_ind / 4)
  lookup <- c(0, NA, 1, 2) # code (0..3) -> genotype (copies of A2 allele)

  geno <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_snps, ncol = n_ind)
  for (s in seq_len(n_snps)) {
    raw_bytes <- as.integer(readBin(con, what = "raw", n = bytes_per_snp))
    c0 <- bitwAnd(raw_bytes, 3L)
    c1 <- bitwAnd(bitwShiftR(raw_bytes, 2L), 3L)
    c2 <- bitwAnd(bitwShiftR(raw_bytes, 4L), 3L)
    c3 <- bitwAnd(bitwShiftR(raw_bytes, 6L), 3L)
    codes <- as.vector(rbind(c0, c1, c2, c3))[seq_len(n_ind)]
    geno[s, ] <- lookup[codes + 1L]
  }
  geno
}

snp_fam_ids <- normalize_fam_ids(snp_fam)
snp_geno <- read_plink_bed(paste0(variant_cfg$SNPs$geno, ".bed"), nrow(snp_bim), nrow(snp_fam))

# Restrict to strains that are actually in sample_used.txt.
keep_idx <- which(snp_fam_ids %in% sample_used$V1)
cat("Strains in sample_used.txt found in the SNP genotype data:", length(keep_idx),
    "out of", nrow(sample_used), "\n")

snp_fam_ids <- snp_fam_ids[keep_idx]
snp_geno <- snp_geno[, keep_idx, drop = FALSE]

# Build indicator matrices (SNPs x strains) for each genotype class and for
# non-missing calls, then use crossprod to get, for every pair of strains,
# the number of SNPs where both are called and the number where they agree.
# This avoids looping over all strain pairs directly (much faster in R).
not_missing <- !is.na(snp_geno)
I0 <- (not_missing & snp_geno == 0) * 1
I1 <- (not_missing & snp_geno == 1) * 1
I2 <- (not_missing & snp_geno == 2) * 1
Mvalid <- not_missing * 1

agree_count <- crossprod(I0) + crossprod(I1) + crossprod(I2)
valid_count <- crossprod(Mvalid)
diff_count <- valid_count - agree_count

rownames(diff_count) <- colnames(diff_count) <- snp_fam_ids

# Only keep the off-diagonal (i != j) pairwise differences.
diag(diff_count) <- NA
pair_idx <- which(upper.tri(diff_count), arr.ind = TRUE)
pairwise_snp_diff <- data.frame(
  Strain1 = rownames(diff_count)[pair_idx[, 1]],
  Strain2 = colnames(diff_count)[pair_idx[, 2]],
  SNP_differences = diff_count[pair_idx],
  Valid_sites = valid_count[pair_idx]
)
# Per-site rate: differences divided by the number of SNP sites where both
# strains were called (accounts for pairs with more/less missingness).
pairwise_snp_diff$SNP_diff_per_site <- pairwise_snp_diff$SNP_differences / pairwise_snp_diff$Valid_sites

# Pair with the most and least SNP differences.
most_diff_pair <- pairwise_snp_diff[which.max(pairwise_snp_diff$SNP_differences), ]
least_diff_pair <- pairwise_snp_diff[which.min(pairwise_snp_diff$SNP_differences), ]

cat("Strain pair with the MOST SNP differences:\n")
print(most_diff_pair)

cat("\nStrain pair with the LEAST SNP differences:\n")
print(least_diff_pair)

cat("\nAverage SNP difference between strains:", mean(pairwise_snp_diff$SNP_differences), "\n")
cat("Median SNP difference between strains:", median(pairwise_snp_diff$SNP_differences), "\n")
cat("Average SNP differences per site between strain pairs:", mean(pairwise_snp_diff$SNP_diff_per_site), "\n")
cat("Median SNP differences per site between strain pairs:", median(pairwise_snp_diff$SNP_diff_per_site), "\n")
```

#Same pairwise-difference analysis for InDels (indel data is already restricted to the 96 strains used in this study).
```{r}
indel_fam_ids <- normalize_fam_ids(indel_fam)
indel_geno <- read_plink_bed(paste0(variant_cfg$InDels$geno, ".bed"), nrow(indel_bim), nrow(indel_fam))

# Restrict to strains that are actually in sample_used.txt.
keep_idx_indel <- which(indel_fam_ids %in% sample_used$V1)
cat("Strains in sample_used.txt found in the InDel genotype data:", length(keep_idx_indel),
    "out of", nrow(sample_used), "\n")

indel_fam_ids <- indel_fam_ids[keep_idx_indel]
indel_geno <- indel_geno[, keep_idx_indel, drop = FALSE]

not_missing <- !is.na(indel_geno)
I0 <- (not_missing & indel_geno == 0) * 1
I1 <- (not_missing & indel_geno == 1) * 1
I2 <- (not_missing & indel_geno == 2) * 1
Mvalid <- not_missing * 1

agree_count_indel <- crossprod(I0) + crossprod(I1) + crossprod(I2)
valid_count_indel <- crossprod(Mvalid)
diff_count_indel <- valid_count_indel - agree_count_indel

rownames(diff_count_indel) <- colnames(diff_count_indel) <- indel_fam_ids
diag(diff_count_indel) <- NA

pair_idx_indel <- which(upper.tri(diff_count_indel), arr.ind = TRUE)
pairwise_indel_diff <- data.frame(
  Strain1 = rownames(diff_count_indel)[pair_idx_indel[, 1]],
  Strain2 = colnames(diff_count_indel)[pair_idx_indel[, 2]],
  InDel_differences = diff_count_indel[pair_idx_indel],
  Valid_sites = valid_count_indel[pair_idx_indel]
)
pairwise_indel_diff$InDel_diff_per_site <- pairwise_indel_diff$InDel_differences / pairwise_indel_diff$Valid_sites

most_diff_pair_indel <- pairwise_indel_diff[which.max(pairwise_indel_diff$InDel_differences), ]
least_diff_pair_indel <- pairwise_indel_diff[which.min(pairwise_indel_diff$InDel_differences), ]

cat("Strain pair with the MOST InDel differences:\n")
print(most_diff_pair_indel)

cat("\nStrain pair with the LEAST InDel differences:\n")
print(least_diff_pair_indel)

cat("\nAverage InDel difference between strains:", mean(pairwise_indel_diff$InDel_differences), "\n")
cat("Median InDel difference between strains:", median(pairwise_indel_diff$InDel_differences), "\n")
cat("Average InDel differences per site between strain pairs:", mean(pairwise_indel_diff$InDel_diff_per_site), "\n")
cat("Median InDel differences per site between strain pairs:", median(pairwise_indel_diff$InDel_diff_per_site), "\n")
```

#Same pairwise-difference analysis for SVs, restricted to the 96 strains used in this study (the SV genotype file contains 1087 samples, so it needs the same sample_used.txt filtering as SNPs).
```{r}
sv_fam_ids <- normalize_fam_ids(sv.fam)
# This SV genotype file stores the strain "AVI" with FID/IID = "AVI"/"1a" (not
# "AVI"/"AVI" like other single-token strains), so normalize_fam_ids() would
# otherwise turn it into "AVI_1a", which wouldn't match sample_used.txt's "AVI".

    "out of", nrow(sample_used), "\n")

sv_fam_ids <- sv_fam_ids[keep_idx_sv]

not_missing <- !is.na(sv_geno)

rownames(diff_count_sv) <- colnames(diff_count_sv) <- sv_fam_ids

pair_idx_sv <- which(upper.tri(diff_count_sv), arr.ind = TRUE)
pairwise_sv_diff <- data.frame(
  Strain1 = rownames(diff_count_sv)[pair_idx_sv[, 1]],
  Strain2 = colnames(diff_count_sv)[pair_idx_sv[, 2]],
  SV_differences = diff_count_sv[pair_idx_sv],
  Valid_sites = valid_count_sv[pair_idx_sv]
)
pairwise_sv_diff$SV_diff_per_site <- pairwise_sv_diff$SV_differences / pairwise_sv_diff$Valid_sites

most_diff_pair_sv <- pairwise_sv_diff[which.max(pairwise_sv_diff$SV_differences), ]
```

#Same pairwise-difference analysis for gene-based CNVs (chr 17 removed), restricted to the 96 strains used in this study. Note that a gene CNV "site" is a gene x coverage-threshold marker, so one gene can contribute several differences.

#Summary table of pairwise divergence (raw counts and per-site rates) across SNPs, InDels, SVs and gene-based CNVs, for reporting how genetically diverged the 96 strains are.
```{r}
# Nuclear genome length, used as the denominator for a genome-wide (rather than
# called-sites-only) divergence rate. The SNP/InDel/SV .bim files all use plain
# chromosome numbers 1-16 (no Mito or Marker/kanMX-natMX cassette variants), so
# only the 16 nuclear chromosomes are summed here.
ref_fai <- read.table(
  "/projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/creating_different_Ref_genomes_for_S288C/customized_ref_genome_with_kan_and_nat_annotations/S.cerevisiae_ref_with_clean_gtf/fasta/genome.fa.fai",
  header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
colnames(ref_fai) <- c("contig", "length", "offset", "linebases", "linewidth")
nuclear_genome_length <- sum(ref_fai$length[!ref_fai$contig %in% c("Mito", "Marker")])
cat("Nuclear genome length (chr I-XVI):", nuclear_genome_length, "bp\n")

pairwise_summary_table <- data.frame(
  `Variant Type` = c("SNPs", "InDels", "SVs", "Gene-based CNVs"),
  `Median pairwise differences` = c(
    median(pairwise_snp_diff$SNP_differences),
    median(pairwise_indel_diff$InDel_differences),
    median(pairwise_sv_diff$SV_differences),
    median(pairwise_cnv_diff$CNV_differences)
  ),
  `Mean pairwise differences` = c(
    mean(pairwise_snp_diff$SNP_differences),
    mean(pairwise_indel_diff$InDel_differences),
    mean(pairwise_sv_diff$SV_differences),
    mean(pairwise_cnv_diff$CNV_differences)
  ),
  `Median per-site rate` = c(
    median(pairwise_snp_diff$SNP_diff_per_site),
    median(pairwise_indel_diff$InDel_diff_per_site),
    median(pairwise_sv_diff$SV_diff_per_site),
    median(pairwise_cnv_diff$CNV_diff_per_site)
  ),
  `Mean per-site rate` = c(
    mean(pairwise_snp_diff$SNP_diff_per_site),
    mean(pairwise_indel_diff$InDel_diff_per_site),
    mean(pairwise_sv_diff$SV_diff_per_site),
    mean(pairwise_cnv_diff$CNV_diff_per_site)
  ),
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Genome-wide divergence rate: median pairwise differences divided by the
# nuclear genome length, instead of by the number of MAF>15% sites analyzed.
# This is the number to quote alongside the per-site (called-sites-only) rate
# above, since the per-site rate only describes divergence among the panel of
# already-known-variable sites, not the genome as a whole.
pairwise_summary_table$`Genome-wide rate (per bp)` <-
  pairwise_summary_table$`Median pairwise differences` / nuclear_genome_length
# Gene-based CNV markers are gene x coverage-threshold bins (several per gene),
# not positions in the genome, so a per-bp rate is not meaningful for them.
pairwise_summary_table$`Genome-wide rate (per bp)`[pairwise_summary_table$`Variant Type` == "Gene-based CNVs"] <- NA

knitr::kable(pairwise_summary_table, row.names = FALSE, digits = c(0, 1, 1, 4, 4, 6))

# Table: pairwise genetic divergence (raw counts, per-site rates, and genome-wide rate) between the 96 strains.
pairwise_summary_table_rounded <- pairwise_summary_table
pairwise_summary_table_rounded[, 2:3] <- round(pairwise_summary_table_rounded[, 2:3], 1)
pairwise_summary_table_rounded[, 4:5] <- round(pairwise_summary_table_rounded[, 4:5], 4)
pairwise_summary_table_rounded[, 6] <- round(pairwise_summary_table_rounded[, 6], 6)
write.csv(pairwise_summary_table_rounded, "../results/Table2_pairwise_diversity_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

#Distribution of minor allele frequency (MAF) across SNPs, InDels, SVs and gene-based CNVs, computed on the same 96 strains used above. This checks how much diversity each variant type is contributing and whether the reported MAF>15% filtering is reflected in the data.
```{r}
# Minor allele frequency per site from a sites x strains genotype matrix
# (codes 0/1/2 = copies of the A2 allele, NA = missing).
compute_maf <- function(geno) {
  alt_freq <- rowMeans(geno, na.rm = TRUE) / 2
  pmin(alt_freq, 1 - alt_freq)
}

maf_snp <- compute_maf(snp_geno)
maf_indel <- compute_maf(indel_geno)
maf_sv <- compute_maf(sv_geno)
maf_cnv <- compute_maf(cnv_geno)

cat("SNP MAF summary:\n"); print(summary(maf_snp))
cat("\nInDel MAF summary:\n"); print(summary(maf_indel))
cat("\nSV MAF summary:\n"); print(summary(maf_sv))
cat("\nGene-based CNV MAF summary:\n"); print(summary(maf_cnv))

maf_df <- rbind(
  data.frame(Variant_Type = "SNPs", MAF = maf_snp),
  data.frame(Variant_Type = "InDels", MAF = maf_indel),
  data.frame(Variant_Type = "SVs", MAF = maf_sv),
  data.frame(Variant_Type = "Gene-based CNVs", MAF = maf_cnv)
)
maf_df$Variant_Type <- factor(maf_df$Variant_Type, levels = c("SNPs", "InDels", "SVs", "Gene-based CNVs"))

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(maf_df, aes(x = MAF, fill = Variant_Type)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.02, boundary = 0, color = NA) +
  facet_wrap(~ Variant_Type, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(SNPs = "#2a78d6", InDels = "#eb6834", SVs = "#1baf7a", `Gene-based CNVs` = "#8e5bd0"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Minor allele frequency (MAF)",
    y = "Number of variants",
    title = "Distribution of minor allele frequency by variant type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
# Per variant, within the 96 strains: minor allele count and
# number of strains carrying at least one copy of the minor allele.
count_minor_carriers <- function(geno) {
  n_called <- rowSums(!is.na(geno))
  a2_count <- rowSums(geno, na.rm = TRUE)          # copies of A2
  a2_minor <- a2_count <= (2 * n_called - a2_count) # is A2 the minor allele here?
  mac      <- pmin(a2_count, 2 * n_called - a2_count)
  carriers <- ifelse(a2_minor,
                     rowSums(geno >= 1, na.rm = TRUE),  # carry >=1 A2
                     rowSums(geno <= 1, na.rm = TRUE))  # carry >=1 A1
  data.frame(MAC = mac, carriers = carriers, n_called = n_called)
}

carrier_list <- list(
  SNPs = count_minor_carriers(snp_geno),
  InDels = count_minor_carriers(indel_geno),
  SVs = count_minor_carriers(sv_geno),
  `Gene-based CNVs` = count_minor_carriers(cnv_geno)
)
maf_list <- list(SNPs = maf_snp, InDels = maf_indel, SVs = maf_sv,
                 `Gene-based CNVs` = maf_cnv)

carrier_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(carrier_list), function(v) {
  x <- carrier_list[[v]]
  data.frame(
    `Variant Type` = v,
    `Min carrier strains` = min(x$carriers),
    `Median carrier strains` = median(x$carriers),
    `Min MAC` = min(x$MAC),
    `% variants with MAF <= 0.15 in the 96` = round(100 * mean(maf_list[[v]] <= 0.15), 1),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}))
knitr::kable(carrier_summary, row.names = FALSE)
```
